dish.title: Thai Pad See Ew with Tofu, Broccoli, and Egg
dish.description: Wide rice noodles stir-fried over high heat with seared extra-firm tofu, broccoli, garlic, and scrambled eggs in a sweet-salty sauce of dark soy sauce, soy sauce, brown sugar, and rice vinegar, finished with white pepper.

recipe_version.title: Thai Pad See Ew with Tofu, Broccoli, and Egg
recipe_version.description: Wide rice noodles stir-fried over high heat with seared extra-firm tofu, broccoli, garlic, and scrambled eggs in a sweet-salty sauce of dark soy sauce, soy sauce, brown sugar, and rice vinegar, finished with white pepper.

ingredients.name: wide rice noodles
ingredients.display_name: dried wide rice noodles (about 3/8 inch) whose label lists rice and water

ingredients.name: extra-firm tofu
ingredients.preparation: patted dry and cut into 1-inch cubes

ingredients.name: neutral oil
ingredients.note: 1 tsp noodles, the rest for searing and stir-frying

ingredients.name: broccoli
ingredients.preparation: cut into small florets, stems peeled and sliced

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Pat the tofu dry and cut it into 1-inch cubes. Cut the broccoli into small florets and slice the peeled stems. Mince the garlic. Stir the dark soy sauce, soy sauce, brown sugar, and vinegar in the small bowl.

steps.title: Cook the noodles
steps.body: Bring 8 cups water to a boil in the 4-quart pot over high, about 10 minutes to come to a boil. Turn off the heat, add the noodles, and soak until pliable but still chewy, about 7 minutes. Drain, rinse under the cold tap for 1 minute, and toss with 1 tsp oil.

steps.title: Sear the tofu
steps.body: While the pot heats (overlap stated): heat 2 tbsp oil in the 12-inch nonstick skillet over medium-high, about 1 minute, and sear the tofu, turning, until golden on several sides, about 8 minutes. Move to a plate.

steps.title: Cook the broccoli
steps.body: Add 1 tbsp oil and the garlic to the skillet for 30 seconds, then the broccoli and 2 tbsp water. Cover and cook until bright green and crisp-tender, about 2 minutes.

steps.title: Stir-fry
steps.body: Turn the heat to high. Push the broccoli aside, add the remaining oil and the eggs, and scramble until just set, about 1 minute. Add the noodles and the sauce and stir-fry, pressing the noodles against the pan and turning them, until glossy and charred in spots, about 4 minutes. Return the tofu and toss 1 minute.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Dust with white pepper and serve right away.
